title: 23 Serious Runway Near-Misses Happened In One Year
hook: Planes and vehicles keep entering the same runway at the wrong moment.
closing: Near-misses reveal where one mistake could become an irreversible collision.
question: Does runway safety worry you?

segments.say: Serious runway near-misses reached 23 in 2023. The annual count more than doubled in a decade.
Pedestrians or vehicles caused 60 percent of runway incursions. Most danger began with someone entering by mistake.
Eight airports account for 33 percent of the worst incursions. The highest risk is concentrated, not random.
